baseline.interpretation: The17 baseline entries without a sprite are machine/AI presentations; their lack in the humanoid sprite catalog is not evidence that they are unplayable. Native bridge owns several.
baseline.flagQualification: All337 entries set fallbackMissingActions=true; the flag alone does not prove any particular required action is missing. Frame aliasing and exact command routes require review.
baseline.parseQualification: One dynamic RescueBoxP35 catalog is not included by the JSON-literal extractor. P35 adds its source explicitly. Dynamic roster additions are outside the literal354 baseline.

admission_contract.admission: src/cqc-pass19-roster-native.js installs only when CQC_COMBAT_SPRITES.has(uid) or CQC_PASS18_MACHINES.has(uid). Keep this guard.
admission_contract.sharedModes: src/cqc-pass26-mode-roster-links.js appends only admitted native identities and authors separate CQCsimulation narratives.
admission_contract.spriteSchema: cqc.combat-sprites/1; stable uid/game/incarnation, independent actions/oppositeActions, per-frame file/SHA256/rect/pivot, reviewed source evidence, fixed per-source standing normalization; no replacement fallback to unrelated incarnations.
admission_contract.machineCapacity: The shared64-rig ceiling is already reached; no guard relaxation without its own load/budget validation. Giant source is not proof of a playable rig.

source_cautions: The current4pendingSurvive registry references are explicitly community index-extract pages, not physically viewed original model captures. Primary gameplay imagery must be obtained before a fidelity1:1 claim.
Une autre époque/apparence de jeu conserve son identité ; un costume ne fusionne jamais Meryl MGS1/MGS4 ou Raiden MGS4/MGR.
fallbackMissingActions:true et catalogCompletion ne prouvent pas à eux seuls une action absente ou une complétude de franchise.
